description: Ireland: weekly Jobseeker's Allowance (2026 or January 2027 rates) after the means test, with your own part-time pay and your partner's pay (assessable pay less EUR20 a day worked up to EUR60, 60% counted), children, savings, or a partner on their own social welfare payment (no adult increase, half-rate children, means halved). Also returns the partner pay at which JA stops. Reproduces both Citizens Information case studies.
